Benfica season|2020–21]] | nextseason = [[2022–23 S.L. Benfica season|2022–23]] }} The 2021–22 [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]] season was the club's 118th season in existence and its 88th consecutive season in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. Domestically, Benfica played in the [[2021–22 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]], were eliminated in the [[2021–22 Taça de Portugal|fifth round of Taça de Portugal]], and reached the [[2021–22 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]] final. In Europe, Benfica reached the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League knockout phase|quarter-finals]] of the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]]. The season started on 4 August 2021, with the [[2021–22 UEFA Champions League qualifying phase and play-off round|third qualifying round of the Champions League]], and concluded on 13 May 2022 with a third-place finish in the league. This was Benfica's second consecutive season and third year without any trophy won.
